raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Remove the duplicate FusedMoEExperts._supports_hash_routing definition that causes repository-wide mypy failures.

## Claims
- Fixes the _supports_hash_routing [no-redef] error.
- Preserves the effective implementation and runtime behavior.

## Validation
- Targeted mypy reproduced the failure before the fix and passed afterward:
```
  .venv/bin/pre-commit run mypy --files vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/modular_kernel.py --hook-stage manual
```
- Remaining changed-file pre-commit checks passed.
- Full-repository mypy no longer reports the duplicate definition; three unrelated Linux-only API errors remain when running on macOS.

## Details
The class defines this static method twice. Both return False, and Python already uses the later definition. This removes the earlier duplicate, retaining the later implementation and its fuller docstring.

No matching open fix PR was found.

---

</details>
